'''Converter Station''' was a business at [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured a sign with a casual, handwritten [[Huttese (alternative writing system)/Legends|alternative Huttese]] font displaying the name of the business in an orange-yellow hue set against a vivid blue backdrop. A cable matching the [[Color/Legends|color]] of the name, representing a converter, extended vertically across the name.<ref name="Brothers" />
